name: from_raw_in
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw_in (raw : * mut T , alloc : A) -> Self
rules: `raw` must point to a block of memory allocated by `alloc`.
For non-zero-sized `T`, the allocation pointed to by `raw` must have the layout `Layout::for_value(&*raw)`.
`raw` must be non-null, including when `T` is zero-sized.
`raw` must be sufficiently aligned for `T`, including when `T` is zero-sized.
`raw` must point to a valid value of `T`.
Calling `Box::from_raw_in(raw, alloc)` transfers ownership of `raw` to the resulting `Box`; repeated calls on the same pointer must not create ownership that would cause a double-free.
